description: PAID (0.25 USDC on Base via x402). Full deterministic website audit as flat JSON: HTTP status, latency, server, title, content fingerprint, robots policy, redirect chain, sitemap, viewport meta, JSON-LD, the full issue list and a 0-100 agent-readiness score. If you call it without a payment you get back the x402 challenge (price, payTo, network) so you can sign an EIP-3009 USDC authorization and retry passing it in the "payment" argument.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 payment payload (the value for the X-Payment header). Omit it on the first call to receive the payment challenge.

name: audit_site
